sloka: दिष्ट्या सर्वस्य लोकस्य प्रवृद्धं दारुणं तमः ।अपावृत्तं त्वया सङ्ख्ये राम रावणजं भयम् ।। ६.१२२.३ ।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā sarvasya lokasya pravṛddhaṁ dāruṇaṁ tamaḥ ।apāvṛttaṁ tvayā saṅkhye rāma rāvaṇajaṁ bhayam ।। 6.122.3 ।।

translations.english: "The dread of Ravana in all the worlds which caused gloom and fear has been fortunately removed by you in the war."
